description: Raise a request on a phone, in Next's three steps: 1 Equipment (the dates first, then picture cards from the catalog, free and priced for them, into a cart), 2 Project (customer first, then project and task from Oracle Fusion, the dates, the delivery point: typed, on a map, or where you stand), 3 Review and submit. Submit for approval and Save draft post exactly what Next's submitChain posts. A draft or a request sent back (My requests, a deep link) opens here; what is being raised is kept on the phone while the signal comes and goes.

view.description: form | sent (a request just sent for approval).

step.description: 1 Equipment | 2 Project | 3 Review and submit (Next's steps); goStepChain moves between them.

mode.description: build | review: review is step 3 (kept for reviewChain).

form.description: The request in the old flow's request shape (orderForm.emptyForm); set by initChain.

cart.description: Cart lines built by catalogCart.itemFromRow; a line can carry its own startDate, endDate and notes.

resume.description: The draft this page saves into {id, requestNumber, attribute1, shipToSiteId}: a reopened one, or the one Save draft created.

catalogShown.description: The rows the list shows (filtered, at most catalogLimit), as orderForm.catalogView reads them.

requestFor.description: project, or customer (raised in New EquipRite, which creates the Fusion sell contract).

canCustomer.description: Manager-tier roles with the customers module on: told where a customer request is raised.

hideRates.description: A quote is coming for project requests (isQuotingAllowed INTERNAL): no prices are shown or posted.

showHours.description: TIMESHEETS_ENABLED: planned hours per day are asked for.

notice.description: Said once above the step: the request this phone kept came back, a request copied into a new one, and so on.

externalDraftId.description: A customer draft asked for here: it is edited in New EquipRite's customer New request.

sent.description: What was last saved from here {id, number, mode: submit | draft, about}.

online.description: Whether the phone has a connection (window online / offline).

sheet.description: The bottom sheet open: cart | customer | project | task | replace | reset, or none.

lineOpen.description: The cart line whose own dates and note are open in the cart sheet (its equipment id).

pending.description: A request asked for while something else is being raised here {id, number, mode}: opened once confirmed.

drafts.description: What to carry on with: your drafts, then requests sent back to you (mobileRequest.carryOn).

draftMore.description: Drafts not shown here (they are in My requests).

recent.description: Your past project requests, to order the same equipment again (mobileRequest.recent).

mapDlg.description: The map sheet for the delivery point (mapChain): its search, results, the point picked, an error in words, and Use my location.

focusRequest.description: Another tab, or a deep link, asked to open a request here (mobileBus.focus('request', { id, number })).

mapPicked.description: From the map (page module mapOpen): a point tapped or dragged to, with its address, or why the map cannot show.

connection.description: The phone went online or offline (window online / offline).
